Title: AeroPulse: Breath & Run Radar
Short_Description: Live PM2.5 air quality, pollen counts, solar UV and outdoor Go/No-Go windows.
Full_Description:
AeroPulse is an environmental intelligence radar engineered for endurance runners, cyclists, parents with young children, and allergy sufferers. It aggregates high-precision atmospheric and space weather feeds to calculate an instant, personalized outdoor "Go / No-Go" window.

KEY FEATURES:

• REAL-TIME GO / NO-GO ENGINE
Evaluates particulate matter, solar UV, and allergen concentrations against your personal activity sensitivity to provide an immediate 0-100 environmental score and safe window recommendation.

• 24-HOUR RADAR TIMELINE
Explore an interactive hourly breakdown of expected PM2.5 spikes, ambient temperature, and UV radiation over the next 24 hours to schedule outdoor workouts at peak clean air times.

• MULTI-PROFILE SENSITIVITY
Switch dynamically between customized activity modes:
- Runners & Athletes: High sensitivity to fine particulate matter (PM2.5) and ground-level ozone (O3).
- Allergy & Asthma Sufferers: Botanical allergen focus prioritizing grass and ragweed pollen.
- Parents & Strollers: Strict solar UV exposure limits and toddler ground-particulate protection.
- Pet Walkers: Ground-level heat alerts, hot asphalt warnings, and dust monitoring.

• BOTANICAL POLLEN RADAR
Detailed botanical concentration monitoring for Grass (Poaceae), Ragweed (Ambrosia), Birch (Betula), and Alder (Alnus) with dominant species detection and risk severity meters.

• AIR PURITY MATRIX
Comprehensive readouts for fine particulates (PM2.5, PM10), US Air Quality Index (AQI), European AQI, ground-level ozone, nitrogen dioxide (NO2), carbon monoxide, and atmospheric dust.

• SOLAR ARC & GOLDEN HOURS
Live solar UV index gauge, peak UV time prediction, sunrise, sunset, and morning and evening golden hour windows.

• NOAA SPACE WEATHER RADAR
Real-time planetary geomagnetic Kp-index telemetry from NOAA SWPC, geomagnetic storm classification (G0 to G5), aurora visibility prospects, and GPS tracking reception advisories for outdoor sports watches.

• WEAR OS COMPANION PREVIEW
Simulate and preview glanceable circular Wear OS watch faces with live Go/No-Go halo score rings and interactive wrist quick tiles.

• SMART RADAR LOCATIONS
Auto-detect coordinates via on-device GPS, search worldwide cities through open geocoding, and store favorite trailheads and running routes locally.

DATA TRANSPARENCY:
Atmospheric air quality, meteorological data, and botanical pollen forecasts are provided by the open Open-Meteo Air Quality and Weather APIs. Planetary space weather telemetry is provided by NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center feeds. AeroPulse operates without mandatory accounts and preserves your privacy.

Privacidad total: sin registro obligatorio y almacenamiento local en el dispositivo.
